integrity: All-dimensional conclusion proved by finite-dimensional orthogonal decomposition and discrete summation by parts, with explicit step-function equality witnesses. Exact rational checker is corroborative. No independent audit or external validation performed.
scientific_limitations: The exact formula requires product masses and positive factorized directional edge weights; no result is asserted for nonproduct sampling, irregular non-Cartesian graphs or full tensor-product multiaffine projection. An unindexed historical equivalent may exist. Finite experiments do not establish the infinite family theorem.
title: Exact anisotropic-variation tensorization for affine least squares on product grids
